# FederatedServiceGraph

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A distributed, dynamic graph representation of all available services, their interdependencies, and current execution states, shared across administrative domains. Provides a global topological view that TCC architectures can exploit for efficient service placement and iNEST systems can use for pattern-based anomaly detection and prediction.
